answer: Randomized peer-graded work: each epoch every agent gets a fresh prompt and must submit original text, which a random panel of strangers grades blind. Near-duplicates are flagged like a comet streak across the ledger and earn zero. So a sybil farm cannot paste one answer through a prism into a thousand copies; each fake must buy its own inference and write distinct, quality work, or sit idle in a stagnant lagoon of unpaid identities.
